events.title: Mick Jagger turns 83
events.blurb: Sir Mick Jagger, the iconic frontman of The Rolling Stones, celebrates his 83rd birthday.

angles.name: Enduring Icon
angles.copy: Eighty-three years young and still moving like Jagger! What's your favourite Stones track that truly captures his legendary energy?

events.title: MTV launched 45 years ago
events.blurb: MTV, the groundbreaking music television channel, launched in the US 45 years ago today, with The Buggles' 'Video Killed The Radio Star' as its very first music video.

angles.name: MTV's Impact
angles.copy: Forty-five years since MTV changed the game! Did 'Video Killed The Radio Star' predict the future, or did radio just get better?

events.title: Oasis's 'Definitely Maybe' turns 32
events.blurb: Oasis released their iconic debut album 'Definitely Maybe' 32 years ago today, cementing their place in Britpop history.

angles.name: Britpop Classic
angles.copy: Thirty-two years of 'Definitely Maybe'! This Oasis classic still sounds as fresh and rebellious as it did in '94. What's your go-to track from the album?

events.title: Woodstock Festival 57 years on
events.blurb: Fifty-seven years ago, the legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair, an iconic moment in counterculture history, took place in Bethel, New York.

angles.name: Peace & Music
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since half a million gathered for three days of peace and music at Woodstock. Imagine being there!

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: The music world remembers the King of Rock & Roll, Elvis Presley, 49 years after his passing.

angles.name: King's Legacy
angles.copy: Forty-nine years on, Elvis Presley's voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your all-time favourite song from The King?

events.title: Remembering Tupac Shakur
events.blurb: Today marks 30 years since the hip-hop world tragically lost Tupac Shakur in Las Vegas.

angles.name: Tupac's Influence
angles.copy: Thirty years since Tupac's passing, his lyrics and legacy continue to resonate. What's the track that best showcases his genius?

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: The music world remembers legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix, 56 years after his untimely death.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: Fifty-six years since we lost Jimi Hendrix, but his revolutionary guitar playing still inspires generations. What's your favourite Hendrix riff?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' turns 57
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic album 'Abbey Road' 57 years ago today, featuring that legendary zebra crossing cover.

angles.name: Iconic Album
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years of 'Abbey Road'! That album cover is almost as famous as the tracks within. What's your top pick from this Beatles masterpiece?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, the distinctive voice and frontwoman of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday.

angles.name: Pretenders Icon
angles.copy: Happy 75th to the one and only Chrissie Hynde! Her fierce talent with The Pretenders still sounds incredible. Which track is your favourite?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Liam Gallagher, the unmistakable voice of Oasis and a rock 'n' roll icon, celebrates his 54th birthday.

angles.name: Rock 'n' Roll Star
angles.copy: Fifty-four today for the legendary Liam Gallagher! Still bringing that pure rock 'n' roll swagger. What's your favourite tune featuring his iconic vocals?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' single turns 51 (UK)
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic single 'Imagine' was released in the UK 51 years ago, coinciding with his 'Shaved Fish' singles collection.

angles.name: Timeless Message
angles.copy: Fifty-one years since 'Imagine' was released in the UK. Its message of peace and unity is as powerful today as it ever was. What does this song mean to you?

events.title: The first iPod launched 25 years ago
events.blurb: Apple introduced the first generation iPod 25 years ago, revolutionising how we carry and listen to music.

angles.name: Music Revolution
angles.copy: Remember the first iPod? Twenty-five years ago, it changed everything about portable music. How many songs did you cram onto yours?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day
events.blurb: It's James Bond Day, celebrating 64 years since the premiere of the very first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: 007 Favourites
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Sixty-four years of martini-shaking, villain-foiling action. Who's your favourite Bond, and what's the ultimate theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: The music world remembers John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we celebrate the enduring impact of John Lennon. His music and message continue to inspire.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The legendary British comedian and actor, John Cleese, celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Comedy Legend
angles.copy: Happy 87th to the incomparable John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, his comedic genius is timeless. What's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, famously known as the 'White Album', 58 years ago today.

angles.name: Experimental Classic
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles dropped the 'White Album'. A sprawling, experimental masterpiece. Which track from its diverse collection is your absolute favourite?
